theorem arc_chars {x : ℝ} (hx : 4.9e26 ≤ x) {q : ℕ} (hq1 : 1 ≤ q) (hqt : (qt q : ℝ) ≤ 300000)
    {β : ℝ} (hβ : |β * x| ≤ 1200000 / qt q) :
    ((if Squarefree q then (1:ℝ) else 0) / q.totient * ‖expTsum (coprimePart q (cP x)) β‖ ^ 2 ≤
        ∑ b ∈ Bset q, ‖expTsum (coprimePart q (cP x)) ((b : ℝ) / q + β)‖ ^ 2 ∧
      ∑ b ∈ Bset q, ‖expTsum (coprimePart q (cP x)) ((b : ℝ) / q + β)‖ ^ 2 ≤
        (if Squarefree q then (1:ℝ) else 0) / q.totient * ‖expTsum (coprimePart q (cP x)) β‖ ^ 2 +
          (4.25e-7 * x) ^ 2) ∧
      ‖expTsum (coprimePart q (cP x)) β - 𝓕 etaPC (-(β * x)) * x‖ ≤ 2.83e-7 * x :=

note: Lean proves only the §14 instance per modulus and uses (1±t) splitting instead of the cross term ET(2|η|₁+ET). Erratum: The display before (10.25) attaches the per-residue error of (10.8) to the sum over φ(q) residues with no factor φ(q): for q = 9973, x = 10⁴ the sum is 3.58 times the per-residue bound (checked by `scripts/checks/eq_10_25.py`).
